visualCharacteristics.purpose: Paged rail of teasers linking to other pages
visualCharacteristics.layout: Three teasers per page with prev/next arrows and dots (>= 720); stacked first three plus load-more button (< 720)
notable: A row may hold several teasers, segmented on headings
Heading link is the teaser link
appear variant slides in on scroll

contentPattern.structure: one row per slide: optional picture, theme paragraph, linked heading, optional text paragraph and optional CTA paragraph

usage: Use to present a set of related or quick-link teasers that page horizontally.
reuseGuidance: Fits many short linked teasers with a theme line; not for a few static cards or long content.
